class.name: IfcBuildingElement
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 6707-1:1989 : Major functional part of a building, examples are foundation, floor, roof, wall. The building element comprises all elements that are primarily part of the construction of a building, i.e., its structural and space separating system.
